features.name: Sap is the source small springy concealable club; compact flattened closed leather interpretation, not a long rigid baton. No intentional holes. Independent manual outer contours remove prior backdrop fringe while preserving ends, neck and head; leather/stitching only in detail, smooth clay retained. Assigned sole final reviewer inspected cited primary page/current raw forms, actual native foregrounds and final2048 masks/teal/paired overlay. Full silhouettes, tips/ends and genuine openings preserved. All raw RGB retained byte-identically in native foreground copies. Common crop/scale/offset only, no warp or independent crop. No broad fringe, clipped subject, detached foreground or background specks. Output2048 is resampled, not native2K. Reference approval only.
